Account snapshot: mid-market B2B SaaS (workflow automation) building a contextual chat assistant + semantic search. Ran 4-week Hosted API trial (Jan 15 - Feb 12). Trial summary and current ask below.

POC Metrics observed (hosted trial):
- Peak observed QPS: 18 qps sustained for 40m during morning batch; typical steady-state 4-6 qps.
- 95th perc latency (generation): 220-300 ms on hosted during trial (token-limited bursts).
- Token mix: average request ~420 input tokens + 300 output tokens = ~720 tokens per call; distribution skewed to longer responses for 'agent' flows.
- Concurrent active streams (approx): 60 user sessions with intermittent long-polling; average concurrency 12-15 in busiest interval.
- Embeddings: batch embed jobs run nightly — ~120k texts/day, avg length 120 tokens.

Customer requirements / asks for Dedicated sizing:
- Baseline QPS target: 25 sustained QPS with predictable latency SLO (p50 < 120ms p95 < 300ms) for generation endpoints.
- Concurrency target: support 150 concurrent open sessions (KV cache preserved across session).
- Burst: 3x baseline burst capacity during marketing spikes (short windows 10-30m).
- Embeddings throughput: 200k texts/day with nightly windows; prefer dedicated GPUs for faster batch runtimes.
- Cost sensitivity: expects cost-per-1M tokens to be at least 30-40% lower than hosted trial.
- Routing/fallback: want fallback to smaller quantized model for non-critical queries; routing by latency policy across regions (NA primary, EU fallback).
- Security: VPC + customer KMS, audit logs retention 12 months, SSO (SAML) for console access, enterprise DPA.

Commercial discussions / POC plan:
- Redwood to deliver Dedicated capacity SOW with node counts and p99 latency simulations by 2026-03-18.
- Pricing scenarios requested: 12-month commit w/ burst buffer vs. on-demand dedicated. Need explicit burst billing terms.
- Technical POC: 2-week Dedicated pilot in customer's VPC (staging) with real traffic replay and KV cache warmup; success criteria: achieve p95 latency <= 300ms and >30% token cost reduction.
